name: io.github.cyanheads/us-lobbying-mcp-server
description: Search US lobbying disclosures and foreign-agent registrations via MCP.

environmentVariables.name: USLOBBYING_LDA_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional registered LDA API token; anonymous access works without it.

environmentVariables.name: USLOBBYING_DATAFRAME_DROP_ENABLED
environmentVariables.description: Enable the local dataframe table deletion tool.

environmentVariables.name: CANVAS_PROVIDER_TYPE
environmentVariables.description: Optional SQL canvas provider: none or duckdb.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_LOG_LEVEL
environmentVariables.description: Sets the minimum log level for output (e.g., 'debug', 'info', 'warn').
